title: 第23章 登徒子！
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“唔！！”

    陆沉被两女压住，让他有些窒息。

    “陆沉弟弟，姐姐们好好跟你说话，你不听是吧？”

    “我不是，我没有……”

    陆沉还想挣扎，但林曦这女人的手劲大得惊人，他一个筑基，在金丹面前根本不够看。

    “没有？那你告诉我，我给你的东西呢？”

    陆沉闭嘴了。

    “乖乖配合，姐姐们不会为难你的，不然……你也不想自己的身份被公之于众吧？”

    魅姬半哄半威胁。

    陆沉看着近在咫尺的那张俏脸，又看了看旁边按着他肩膀、别过脸去的林曦，忽然不挣扎了。

    他算是明白了，今晚这关，他过不去了。

    认命了。

    但他的心里，忽然涌起一股邪火。

    凭什么？凭什么一个个都来找他？庄静白是这样，姜怀玉是这样，现在连魔门的都找上门来了？他也是有情绪的人！

    他看向林曦。

    绝美冷艳的脸，令人心动的身材，这么极品的女人，偏偏要如此招惹自己。

    他心里忽然冒出一个念头。

    既然魅姬不能惹，但这个……

    “行，我配合。”

    魅姬眼睛一亮：“真的？”

    “真的，但你们这样按着我，我怎么做？”

    “那你快点！”魅姬拉着林曦背过身去，两女耳根再次微红。

    但是陆沉没动，他看了一眼背对着他的两女，嘴角微微翘起。

    “林曦师姐。”

    林曦的背影僵了一下。

    “你能不能……转过来一下？”

    “什么？”林曦的声音明显在发抖。

    “这种事情，我需要环境，一个人根本就行不通。”

    林曦沉默了三秒，慢慢转过身来。

    此刻她脸上没了清冷，满是红晕，并且已经蔓延到了脖子。

    目光落在陆沉脸上，又像是烫到了一样迅速移开。

    “什……什么事？”
content_en:
"Ugh!!"

Lu Chen was suppressed by the two women, which made him suffocate.

"Brother Lu Chen, my sisters are talking to you properly, but you don't listen, right?"

"I'm not, I didn't..."

Lu Chen still wanted to struggle, but Lin Xi's hands were astonishingly strong. His foundation building was not enough in front of Jin Dan.

"No? Then tell me, what about the things I gave you?"

Lu Chen shut up.

"Cooperate and your sisters won't make things difficult for you. Otherwise... you don't want your identity to be made public, right?"

Mei Ji half coaxed and half threatened.

Lu Chen looked at the pretty face close at hand, then at Lin Xi who was holding his shoulder and looking away, and suddenly stopped struggling.

He finally understood that he couldn't pass this test tonight.

Accepted.

But an evil fire suddenly surged in his heart.

Why?Why are they all coming to him?Zhuang Jingbai is like this, Jiang Huaiyu is like this, and now even people from the Demon Sect have come to visit?He is also an emotional person!

He looked at Lin Xi.

With a stunningly beautiful face and an exciting figure, such a top-notch woman wanted to provoke herself like this.

An idea suddenly came to his mind.

Since Mei Ji cannot be messed with, but this...

"Okay, I'll cooperate."

Mei Ji's eyes lit up: "Really?"

"Really, but if you hold me down like this, what should I do?"

"Then hurry up!" Mei Ji pulled Lin Xi's back, and the two women's ears turned red again.

But Lu Chen did not move. He glanced at the two women with their backs to him and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.

"Senior Sister Lin Xi."

Lin Xi's back stiffened.

"Can you... turn around?"

"What?" Lin Xi's voice was obviously trembling.

"I need an environment for this kind of thing. It just won't work on my own."

Lin Xi was silent for three seconds and slowly turned around.

At this moment, her face lost its coldness and was filled with blush, which had spread to her neck.

His eyes fell on Lu Chen's face, and he quickly moved away as if he was burned.

"What...what happened?"
